ErrorCode.description: A stable error code. Branch on the code, never on the message.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

Method.description:
What the job computes. `run`: one expectation value per observable. `sample`:
measurement counts. `probabilities`: the probability of every basis state.
`zero_state_probability`: the probability of the all-zeros state.
`photonic_sample`: the photon counts of a linear-optical circuit, sampled on a
photonic device.
Method.title: Method

description:
The price of a job and whether a submit would be accepted now. Amounts are
integers in micro-USD: 1000000 is $1. `vendor_cost_usd_micro` plus `fee_usd_micro`
equals `estimate_usd_micro`.

available_usd_micro.description: Your balance minus your active holds, at the time of the call. 0 for a job that is free on the router, whose estimate does not read the balance.
available_usd_micro.title: Available Usd Micro

estimate_usd_micro.description: The amount a submit would hold from your balance. 0 for a job that is free on the router: an IBM Quantum job, or a job on a device in limited preview.
estimate_usd_micro.title: Estimate Usd Micro

fee_usd_micro.description: The EigenOrbit fee inside the estimate.
fee_usd_micro.title: Fee Usd Micro

price_version.description: The price version used, `<device>@<version>`, for example `braket/sv1@1`. A job keeps the version it was admitted with.
price_version.title: Price Version

vendor_cost_usd_micro.description: The vendor's cost inside the estimate, rounded up.
vendor_cost_usd_micro.title: Vendor Cost Usd Micro

would_reject_reason.description: Null when a submit would be accepted now. Otherwise the error code the submit would be refused with, the first that applies of `device_unavailable`, `method_not_supported`, `shots_invalid`, `terms_not_accepted`, `ibm_connection_invalid`, `ibm_account_not_connected`, `device_access_restricted`, `concurrency_limit_exceeded`, `key_budget_exceeded`, `negative_balance` and `insufficient_balance`.

title: EstimateOut
